review.chain: DUB17 Theorem2.6 / DUB18 Cor8.2 -> literal higher symmetric-power continuation -> automorphy -> original all-weight characteristic-zero association -> homogeneous Gamma1 Hecke-character realization -> original genus preservation -> reverse genus -> finite elliptic residue fibers -> original-field marked-point chart and its stabilizers.
review.shorterRoute: Use the existing rational-coordinate embedding and native transcendental rational-function equivalence instead of reconstructing fraction fields; use the proved exact Tate point and native equal-j variable change; descend the field embedding by algebraically closed polynomial roots and the point by the existing torsion specialization theorem; bound normalized embeddings by native adjoin extensionality and card_algHom_le_finrank. This avoids a new equalizer/cardinality framework and additional torsion census. The final consumer constructs every chart input from the actual residue field and original Gamma1 field.
assumptionsToDischarge: The literal Tate j invariant equals the original jq series, by an integral discriminant identity before base change, including characteristics two and three.
An actual embedding of the original modular-function field and an exact-order point exist over the algebraic closure of the source generic j field, with all unit-multiple coordinate identities.
No scalar-compatibility certificate remains in the actual consumer: the common extension is constructed and compatibility is reflexive.
The original residue degree proves finiteness and bounds normalized field embeddings by the signed Gamma1 index.
Any generic-field automorphism fixing the constructed original-field embedding fixes its actual marked point up to sign; both coordinate invariants separate abscissae in every characteristic.
review.remaining: The opposite stabilizer inclusion, primitive-point Galois orbit cardinality, diamond lift, finite elliptic-fiber bounds, reverse genus, and downstream association and higher continuation remain required. Acceptance16/20; DUB17--20 OPEN.
review.boundary: Scratch-audited scope only after the checks pass; promotion and assembled verification pending. Only one stabilizer inclusion is claimed.
